collectible.title: Hina's underpants
collectible.text:
Aoi's favorite panties. They're the kind of thing you'd expect to find in any bedroom in the world - they're as plain as what any prison inmate might wear, but still completely comfortable. The one drawback is that they turn totally see-through if you go swimming in them.
It seems like Hope's Peak students give their friends underwear. No one knows why.
collectible.unlock: Outlast Hina in a game with three other Danganronpa characters (you don't have to win).
